Subject: Outbound access inventory needed for Private Connector onboarding

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday — Northbridge is moving quickly on the Private Connector pilot. Before we can finish our internal signoff we need a clear outbound inventory and proof points for our security team. Specifically: 

- Definitive list of IP addresses (or ranges) that Redwood will use from the control plane for Private Connectors (both static and ephemeral if any).
- Explanation of ownership: which IPs are customer-owned vs Redwood-owned vs cloud-provider NAT.
- Expected egress ports and protocols (DNS, HTTPS, TLS versions).
- A short evidence pack we can hand to our auditors (screenshot of routing, example firewall rule, and a one-page statement of responsibility).

Can you share a single spreadsheet or PDF with the above? We prefer to have separate columns for: IP, ownership, CIDR, purpose, TTL/rotation cadence, and any required inbound firewall holes.

We'd like to complete this by Monday EOD (PST) if possible.

Thanks,
Alice Morgan\Senior IT Security Manager\Northbridge Health

Hi all,

Attached is the initial IP inventory spreadsheet and a short technical note. High-level summary here so Alice's team can preview: 

1) Control plane outbound (API & telemetry):
   - 34.198.120.12/32 — Redwood-owned (static) — controlplane.api.redwood-inference.com — purpose: API calls, provisioning; TTL: static; ownership: Redwood
   - 34.198.120.13/32 — Redwood-owned (static) — telemetry.redwood-inference.com — purpose: metrics and health; TTL: static; ownership: Redwood

2) Connector egress for private deployments (customer-dedicated pools or NATed):
   - 10.0.0.0/24 — customer-owned (example placeholder) — local NAT ranges for on-prem connector (replace with customer-submitted ranges)
   - 52.24.0.0/20 — cloud-provider NAT (ephemeral) — used for burst egress in hosted Dedicated; TTL: rotates per cloud policy; not for customer firewall whitelisting unless pinned

3) DNS and TLS: outbound to port 53 (UDP/TCP) for DNS resolvers and TCP 443 for HTTPS. Redwood supports TLS1.2+; we recommend TLS1.3 for reduced latency where available.

4) Ports and protocols required for control plane callbacks: TCP 443 outbound (HTTPS), optional TCP 22 for debug with prior scheduling (restricted).

Notes on ownership and guidance:
- Static control plane IPs (first block) are owned by Redwood and we can provide justification and reverse DNS entries.
- For private on-prem connectors, the connector will egress via the customer's NAT/edge. We will provide recommended ephemeral ranges if the customer chooses to route via Redwood-managed NAT.
- If Northbridge requires fixed egress IPs for connector traffic, we can offer a reserved NAT allocation on Dedicated for an additional subscription (this maps to Reserved Capacity contracts).

Attachments included: nbh-request-ips.xlsx (sheet: ip_inventory), redwood-private-connector-ip-delegation.pdf (one-page responsibility statement).

I'll also include an example Palo Alto rule you can drop-in:
- source: [Northbridge connector CIDR]
- destination: 34.198.120.12/32, 34.198.120.13/32
- service: application-default (HTTPS)
- action: allow
- description: Allow Private Connector control plane and telemetry to Redwood

If Northbridge prefers, we can generate a smaller CSV with concrete CIDRs for your firewall team to import.

Aditya
Senior Network Engineer, Redwood Inference

- Routing diagram (L3) showing connector -> customer NAT -> internet -> Redwood control plane (PNG/PDF)
- Network flow logs sample showing a successful session to 34.198.120.12:443 with timestamps (redacted IPs allowed)
- Reverse DNS/proof of ownership for the static IPs (screenshot from our IP owner records)
- A short statement of responsibilities (we attached the PDF); please confirm the acceptance of the responsibility split: Redwood owns control plane IPs and TLS termination; Northbridge is responsible for connector egress NAT and local firewall rules unless they purchase reserved NAT.

Action items: 
- Alice: confirm whether you need the flow-log sample and routing diagram redacted or with full data.
- Priya: please surface the contractual checkbox for reserved NAT (pricing/commitment) if Northbridge requests fixed egress IPs.
